title: Built a tool which discourages you to trade in the era where literally every tool and platform is encouraging you to trade
author: Arshfutures
selftext:
Hey guys, I have Built a Tool which directly connects to hyperliquid and it enforces rules which you yourself set. So basically you set your own trading rules when you are sober and my tool enforces those rules. Because I felt everyone’s focused right now on making strategies but the main game is psychology in trading and if there is something which prevents you to tilt and won’t let your trade when you are titled a lot of people can become profitable. For example you setup your rule that you don’t want to loose more than 1% in a single trading day you setup that when you are sober in my tool ( it’s called Steddy.xyz btw) now steddy will make sure to when you hit 1% it will close all the trades and won’t let your trade anymore until the next trading day  
 resumes, so it’s just one example I  gave you , there are many like revenge trade you can make your own rules and my tool will enforce it when you break your own rules. Do you guys have any more suggestions ? And if you have time please  stress test it its still Beta.
